title: Security evidence workbook: SIEM export + RBAC v2 guidance
body:
Purpose and audience:
This workbook is a draft customer-facing artifact and an internal playbook that bridges three related threads: RBAC v2 controls, audit log schema (for internal and customer audit), and SIEM export/evidence automation. Primary audience: security reviewers at customer orgs, compliance reviewers, and Redwood Solutions Engineers preparing trust-center collateral. Secondary audience: SRE/product teams implementing export and evidence pipelines.

Scope and approach:
- Deliver a concise one-pager for external use (top of doc) and a longer internal section with recommended export fields, canonical event names, sample queries for common customer Qs, and an automated evidence checklist.
- Keep language non-technical where possible for the customer-facing bits; include an appendix with field-level detail for SIEM/engineering.

1) Customer-facing one-pager (summary)
Redwood Inference: security controls you can rely on (short)
- RBAC v2: Role-based access controls with least-privilege roles, policy inheritance, and time-bound temporary elevation. Admins can create custom roles and scope them by project, model, and environment (prod/staging). Audit trail is generated for every role/permission change.
- Audit logs: Immutable, tamper-evident logs for authentication, authorization decisions, model access, deployment events, and evidence exports. Retention configurable per contract.
- SIEM export: We provide near-real-time streaming of normalized JSON events to customer SIEM solutions (S3, Kafka, Splunk HTTP Event Collector, or syslog). Exports include field mappings and sample dashboards.
- Evidence automation: Customer portal and API for retrieving packaged evidence (crypto-signed bundles of config + logs + screenshots) for compliance reviews. Optional scheduled evidence deliveries.
- Next steps: For questionnaires, request our canned answers + attachments. For live demos, we can simulate SIEM export to your dev environment.
